scenes.voice: This is OVERTURN. It answers a health-insurance denial with evidence. This is the system running.

scenes.sub: 34. Sydney. Northbridge Health denied her lumbar MRI.
scenes.voice: Ava is thirty-four. Northbridge Health denied her lumbar MRI. Four reasons. Three are contradicted by the file.

scenes.note: Every read is a read-only run_sql call through Zetaris.
scenes.voice: Every fact comes through one door: Zetaris. Seven tables: policy, denial, medical record, benefits, procedure codes, claim documents and diagnosis codes.

A planner queries. A reconciler builds the ledger. A critic attacks it. An advocate argues the insurer's side. Either can force a re-query. A deterministic scorer grades it, and a reporter writes the packet.

scenes.note: SAMPLE_MODE: the same control flow, deterministic model stubs, a SQLite mirror of the Zetaris tables. Every step is traced.
scenes.voice: One command runs the loop. This run is sample mode: same control flow, deterministic stubs, SQLite mirror. Every step is traced.

scenes.rightValue: POL-4.3 excludes spinal fusion — it states it does not apply to diagnostic MRI of the lumbar spine. POL-4.1 covers this scan.
scenes.voice: Reason one: they call the MRI experimental. The clause they cite excludes spinal fusion, not diagnostic imaging. The clause that applies covers this scan. Rebutted.

scenes.claim: The contrast MRI is not covered.
scenes.rightValue: The denial cites MRI-LS-002, the contrast study. The order, the EOB and the record all use MRI-LS-001 — no contrast, no prior authorisation.
scenes.voice: Reason two: they cite the contrast study, which needs prior authorisation. The order and the record use the non-contrast code. Code mismatch. Rebutted.

scenes.rightValue: Twelve physiotherapy sessions across twelve weeks, plus an NSAID trial. The policy asks for six weeks. The treatment is documented.
scenes.citation: medical_records · REC-002 to REC-013 · line L0018
scenes.voice: Reason three: no conservative treatment documented. The record shows twelve physiotherapy sessions over twelve weeks. The policy asks for six. Rebutted.

scenes.rightValue: DOC-003, the specialist referral letter, is genuinely absent. Requested 20 August. Not received.
scenes.note: The appeal is conditional. OVERTURN will not fabricate the letter.
scenes.voice: Reason four: a specialist letter is missing. It is genuinely missing. OVERTURN names the exact document and refuses to invent it. The appeal is conditional, not perfect.

scenes.note: Each line carries its source row, verification status and a SHA-256 hash chained to the line before it. Change one row and the chain breaks.
scenes.voice: Forty-seven evidence lines. Each carries its source row, its status, and a SHA-256 hash chained to the line before it. Change one row and the chain breaks.

scenes.big: Remove a source. Watch the score.
scenes.note: Counterfactual scoring: every source has to earn its place in the packet.
scenes.voice: Remove a source and the score tells you what it was worth. Pull the policy, the record, or the codes, and eighty-four drops to sixty-five.

scenes.big: Plumbing we did not have to rebuild.
cards: The only data path. Seven tables, one tool: run_sql. Read-only by construction.
Persistent case memory. Recalls the insurer's denial pattern across runs.
The shared ledger the Reconciler and Critic both mutate and read.
Primary model provider. Critic and Advocate are pinned to NVIDIA Nemotron.
scenes.note: Every request logs the model that actually served it.
scenes.voice: Zetaris is the only data path: one tool, run SQL. Meterless H-MEM remembers the case across runs. The World Model is the shared ledger. Nightshift is the primary model provider, with critic and advocate pinned to NVIDIA Nemotron.

scenes.big: One document a human can send.
items: to Northbridge Health, dated, ready to sign
each with clause, code and record citations
scenes.voice: The output is one document a human can send: cover letter, four cited rebuttals, evidence map, and one action left — get the letter.

scenes.sub: 84 — solid — conditional.  Supply DOC-003 and it becomes 100 — ready.
scenes.voice: Eighty-four. Solid. Conditional. Supply the letter, and it becomes one hundred. The denial, answered.
